counting_method: Page-aware extracted text bounded by printed headings and reconciled against all 26 rendered pages. ambiguities: The six-paragraph abstract on page 1 is image-layer content and has no usable extracted text; its final layout is visually counted.
Introduction is treated as the complete opening architecture on pages 3-5: background, task restatement, literature gap, and workflow preview.
The three benefit submodels and their scalar coupling form one model-establishment chapter across pages 7-14 because their repeated internal architecture is the main reusable writing pattern.
Section 4.4.2 is separated as algorithm because it translates the scalar objective and constraints into the stated SLSQP search procedure.
Results includes constraints, both destinations, key-parameter interpretation, and the first result-linked curve on page 19; section 6 begins below that curve.

Additional Income and Expenditure Plan starts on image-layer page 19 and continues with one sentence on page 20; it is mapped to model-improvement because it proposes feedback channels that could extend the static optimization, although the paper does not actually close those feedback edges.
Conclusion spans pages 21-22 so the destination-comparison table and less-visited-location measures are retained as the final transfer synthesis rather than omitted as an unheaded appendix.
The memo on page 25 is a visually distinct stakeholder chapter; references and the AI-use report are source context, not positive prose chapters.
